name: Snyk
scope_notes: Snyk SaaS; API access, service accounts and audit logs require the Enterprise plan, while Free/Team personal tokens work only for CLI/IDE/CI.

controls.name: PAT expiry (max 90 days)
controls.what: Every PAT has an expiry no later than 90 days; users choose the date.

controls.name: Revoke PAT
controls.what: The owner revokes a PAT in the UI or via DELETE /self/personal_access_tokens/{id}.
controls.setting: Account settings > Personal access tokens > Revoke; DELETE /rest/self/personal_access_tokens/{personal_access_token_id}

controls.name: Revoke & Regenerate
controls.what: The owner invalidates the legacy API token and gets a new one; integrations stop immediately.

controls.name: Service account role
controls.what: The assigned Group or Org role (incl. custom roles) sets what the token can do; Group Viewer gives read-only.
controls.setting: Group/Org Settings > Service accounts > Role; role_id in POST /service_accounts

controls.name: Service account creation restricted to admins
controls.what: Only Group admins (Group accounts) or Org Admins/Group admins (Org accounts) can create service accounts.

controls.name: access_token_expires_at
controls.what: Expiry date for access_token service accounts, at most one year.

controls.name: Delete service account
controls.what: Deletes the account and invalidates its token or credentials immediately.

controls.name: access_token_ttl_seconds
controls.what: Lifetime of OAuth access tokens issued to the service account (default 1h, 1h-24h).

controls.name: Manage client secret (create/delete/replace)
controls.what: Rotate or delete OAuth service account secrets; replace is the compromise response.

controls.name: Snyk App scopes
controls.what: App permissions are fixed Org-level scopes, and an installer cannot grant scopes beyond their own permissions.

controls.name: Revoke authorized Snyk App
controls.what: User revokes an app from Authorized Snyk Apps; admins can delete Group/Org installs by API.
controls.setting: Account Settings > Authorized Snyk Apps > Revoke; DELETE /rest/groups/{group_id}/apps/installs/{install_id}; DELETE /rest/self/apps/installs/{install_id}

controls.name: Delete App / replace clientSecret
controls.what: Deleting an app revokes its credentials and all installs; replacing the secret invalidates the old one at once.

controls.name: OAuth2 revoke endpoint
controls.what: Revokes a specific refresh token immediately.

controls.name: Audit logs
controls.what: Group and Org audit log search (90 days) incl. service account and app lifecycle and api.access events.

controls.name: Install Apps (Snyk Apps management permission)
controls.what: Role permission that allows installing Snyk Apps; the pre-defined Org Collaborator role does not have it, and custom roles can leave it off.
controls.setting: Group > Settings > Member roles > Snyk Apps management > Install Apps

no_control.what: Legacy personal API tokens cannot be given an expiry; they never expire.
auth_type api_key service accounts never expire.
PATs cannot be created through the API (UI only), so no admin-driven issuance flow.

controls_unknown: Whether PATs, legacy API tokens or service account tokens bypass SSO / IdP conditional access (not stated).
Any admin setting to disable PATs or legacy API tokens, or to revoke another user's personal token (none documented).
Whether removing a user from a Group/Org or the IdP invalidates their PAT/legacy token (not stated).
Any customer IP allowlist for API requests (none documented).
Audit event names for PAT and legacy token create/revoke (not in the documented event lists).
Contents of api.access events (which fields identify the token or service account).
Admin approval or allowlist for Snyk App installation.
Refresh token lifetime for Snyk Apps.

authentication.summary: User-created token sent as `Authorization: token <PAT>` or via SNYK_TOKEN for CLI/IDE. Acts as the user. API use needs Enterprise; Free/Team tokens work only for CLI/IDE/CI.

federation.details: Static bearer token; no workload identity federation.

ip_restriction.boundary: Snyk docs describe no customer-configurable IP allowlist for API callers; IP lists in docs cover Snyk scanners reaching your targets.

renewal.expiry_basis: fixed expiry date chosen at creation
renewal.summary: Create a new PAT before the old one expires (up to 3 active).

administration.summary: Users create (UI only) and revoke their own PATs. No admin-side disable, policy or revoke for other users' PATs is documented. SSO/IdP bypass not documented (not_verified).

offboard.details: Removing a user from a Group removes their access to its Organizations and Projects, but docs do not say the PAT itself is revoked.

inventory.details: Only the owning user can list their own PATs (Personal access tokens tab, GET /self/personal_access_tokens); no admin-wide listing documented.

offboard.ui: Group > Members > trash icon next to user > Delete member

credentials.name: Service account token (auth_type access_token or legacy api_key)

authentication.summary: Group- or Org-level system user whose token is shown once at creation and used like a user token. access_token type has an expiry; api_key type is a legacy key with no expiry.

ip_restriction.boundary: Snyk docs describe no customer-configurable IP allowlist for API callers; IP lists in docs cover Snyk scanners reaching your targets.

lifetime.summary: access_token: up to 1 year; api_key: never expires

renewal.summary: On expiry you must create a new service account.

administration.summary: Group admins create Group accounts; Org Admins (Group members) or Group admins create Org accounts. Role sets scope; Org accounts cannot exceed creator's privileges; read-only only via Group Viewer. Admins delete to revoke.

offboard.details: Service accounts are system users tied to the Group or Organization, not to a person.

inventory.details: Settings > Service accounts lists them; API GET /rest/groups/{groupId}/service_accounts and GET /rest/orgs/{orgId}/service_accounts.

federation.details: private_key_jwt: Snyk verifies JWTs signed with customer keys published at a customer-hosted HTTPS JWKS URL. Not cloud workload identity federation.

administration.summary: Same creation rights and roles as other service accounts. Secrets can be created, deleted or replaced; account deletion revokes credentials.

credentials.name: Snyk Apps (OAuth 2.0 apps: user or tenant context)

authentication.summary: OAuth 2.0 apps created in an Org. Interactive installs use authorization code (PKCE) and get access + refresh tokens sent as `Authorization: bearer`; apps can also be installed for unattended client_credentials use.

ip_restriction.boundary: Snyk docs describe no customer-configurable IP allowlist for API callers; IP lists in docs cover Snyk scanners reaching your targets.

lifetime.summary: Access token TTL set per app (1h-24h); refresh token single-use

renewal.expiry_basis: refresh token expiry; rotates on each use
renewal.summary: Refresh token exchanged for new pair; old one invalid.

administration.summary: Scopes are Org-level and capped by the installer's permissions. user-context apps lose access when the installer is deactivated; tenant-context installs persist with the Org. Users revoke in Authorized Snyk Apps; admins revoke installs via API; deleting the app revokes all installs. No documented admin approval or allowlist for app installs.

offboard.details: User-context apps lose access when the installing user deactivates their account; tenant-context apps are not tied to the user.

inventory.details: Admins can list apps the Organization created (GET /rest/orgs/{orgId}/apps/creations); the Authorized Snyk Apps page shows only the viewing user's authorizations.

expiry.api: Set access_token_ttl_seconds (3600-86400) in POST https://api.snyk.io/rest/orgs/{org_id}/apps/creations or PATCH /rest/orgs/{org_id}/apps/creations/{app_id}

offboard.ui: Group > Members > Delete member (user-context apps lose access when the installing user deactivates); tenant-context: Authorized Snyk Apps page > Revoke
